steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. It has no other fields. Leave Todo and nextId unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export type Command = { kind: "add"; title: string; due?: string; } | { kind: "complete"; id: number; } | { kind: "list"; } | { kind: "clear"; };

steps.instruction: Add a 'clear' command that removes completed todos. The request calls them 'completed'; in our Todo type that is the `done` field. (1) Export a new pure function `clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[]`. It returns a new array with every todo whose `done` is true removed. The remaining todos keep their order and are not changed. It must not mutate the input array. (2) The Command type from ./types now has a variant `{ kind: "clear" }` (types is adding it in this round). Make parseArgs return `{ kind: "clear" }` when the command word is "clear". Read argv the same way the existing add/complete/list commands do. (3) Make run(path, { kind: "clear" }) load the todos from path, apply clear, save the result to path, and return a short confirmation message saying how many todos were removed (for example "Cleared 2 completed todos"). Do not change the behaviour of the existing commands. Add unit tests in src/commands.test.ts.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: This adds a "clear" variant to the Command type and implements it in commands: a pure clear() function, plus handling in parseArgs and run. Todo has no "completed" field. "Completed" means the existing `done` boolean, which is what the complete command sets.
